name: Midorikawa Kotone
source:
She is bright, honest, and kind to everyone. She is impeccable and in a sense, an ideal woman. She is so pretty that she has a kind of fan club, but she does not like to be pampered.

She becomes friends with the main character as she teaches him. (The main character is really smart and has excellent grades.)

People who know rumors about the main character run away and do not want to come near him. Therefore, she is also convenient. She feels comfortable with him because he is not pushy. She is a caring person and mends the the main chracter's torn pants.

Favorite foods: Meat pie, gratin, chocolate and banana crepe, cafe au lait without sugar

Favorite movies: Romance movies.

Favorite music: J-POP

Special skills: Making cakes

Hobbies: Window shopping

Things to do during days off: Reading, walking her dog

Future goals: open a day care center

People I respect: my parents

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_miko.html]official site[/url]]
